items.title: The index of a lattice and its image under an automorphism equals the order of the determinant
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors
items.source_version: Stacks Project git a04446e57ec1 (2026-07-28); file algebra.tex; corpus local snapshot 20261012
items.difficulty_reason: The lemma states that for a one-dimensional Noetherian local domain and a linear automorphism of a finite dimensional vector space, the index of any lattice against its image equals the order of the determinant of the automorphism (statement lines 30182-30191). The proof does not compute determinants of matrices over the fraction field directly: it first shows the index is independent of the lattice by an additivity argument, then reduces the automorphism by elementary operations to a diagonal shape where the order of the determinant is immediate (proof lines 30193-30252). The reduction to the diagonal case is the step that carries the computation. H2.
